overview: An isolated continent world where the Lost Tribe of Sith survived for millennia after a crash landing.
history:
Kesh appears in records spanning the Old Republic, Clone Wars, Imperial era, Galactic Civil War, and Legacy periods. Archaeological surveys, holocrons, and veteran testimony preserve its place in galactic history.

Strategic value, cultural identity, and Force-sensitive traditions on Kesh shifted with each regime—from Sith occupation to Republic restoration and beyond.
significance: Kesh remains a reference point in Wild Space surveys, trade lane charts, and military campaign planning across the nine saga films, series, KOTOR, and the Old Sith Empire.
notableEvents: Surveyed during the Old Republic expansion into Wild Space
Referenced in Clone Wars and Imperial era records
Documented in Knights of the Old Republic archives
Listed in Old Sith Empire star charts

timeline.event: First major settlement era on Kesh
